sources.title: Ornith AI
sources.snippet: Ornith-1.5 takes a major step toward building foundation models through end-to-end self-improvement, extending the self-scaffolding framework introduced in Ornith-1.0 into a more complete self-improvement loop: the model proposes new tasks, generates task-specific scaffolds, and produces solution rollouts.

sources.snippet: Aloha! 🌺 Ornith is a family of self-improving open-source models for agentic tasks. This repo covers both generations: 🐦 Ornith-1.5 (latest) — extends self-scaffolding into a complete end-to-end self-improvement loop: the model proposes new tasks, generates task-specific scaffolds, and produces solution rollouts for reinforcement learning. sources.snippet: Serving Ornith-1.0 Ornith-1.0 ships as a dense 9B model plus two Mixture-of-Experts models (35B, 397B). All checkpoints expose the same OpenAI-compatible interface and support a 256K (262,144-token) context window; the dense 9B fits on a single 80GB GPU, while the MoE checkpoints are sharded across a multi-GPU node with tensor parallelism.
